The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Police conducted raid/압수수색 on Central and local election commissions regarding ballot paper shortage scandal in local elections
2. Court failed to secure evidence (ballot boxes with printed quantities) because election commission already collected and sent them to disposal company
3. At Jamsil polling station, ballot boxes showed 1900 ballots printed for 3800 voters (less than 50%), but election commission claims they followed internal guidelines
4. Investigation revealed that while some stations had shortages, others had excess ballots (42,000 unused in Songpa-gu total)
5. Jamsil 4-dong 7th polling station should have received 1921 ballots (60% of voters) but only got 1400, causing 3-hour delays
